artists.name: Aaron McFaddon
artists.desc: I have been playing guitar for 25 years, gigging for the last 15 years and has been playing Ukulele for the last 5 years. For years Aaron has been teaching lessons at the YMCA. He enjoys playing at the Silverdale waterfront and you have probably seen him play around Kitsap County at Farmers Markets, Restaurants and Yoga Studios.

artists.name: Allison Hanlon
artists.desc: Singer, flutist, songwriter, graphic designer, visual artist, and performer whose work blends music, movement, storytelling, and visual design into unforgettable experiences. She is known for her captivating stage presence and creative versatility, Allison has spent years building a career that bridges multiple artistic disciplines. Whether performing on stage, designing promotional materials, creating visual art, or developing original music, her passion lies in creating meaningful experiences that inspire connection, wonder, and joy.

artists.name: Amandanaband
artists.desc: Amandanband a duo subset of Bandits of the Animal Kingdom

artists.name: Amber Pizl
artists.desc: Country/Rock | Singer-Songwriter | Storyteller. From Florida to the PNW. Raw Lyrics. Real Life. Heart Music.

artists.name: Angelina Adams
artists.desc: A gifted artist well-known for her enthralling fusion of pop and indie pop. Adams has established a reputation for herself in the music business because of her distinctive style and moving lyrics. With a sound palette that is both catchy and reflective, Adams blends indie sensibilities with pop melodies, drawing inspiration from a broad spectrum of musical genres. Her songs have a strong emotional impact on listeners because they frequently tackle topics of love, self-discovery, and the complexity of interpersonal relationships.

artists.name: Anna Robinson
artists.desc: A country-rock flavored singer-songwriter raised in South Dakota, now living in Union, WA

artists.name: AuraShine
artists.desc: The band began as a duo in 2019 with Laura (Aura) and Shawn (Shine), and has since expanded into an evolving collective. Whether performing as a duo, trio, or full band, their sound adapts to each space – intimate sets to expansive outdoor festival stages. Their sound has been described as enchanting, ethereal, blending soulful, eclectic textures and uplifting groove, with heartfelt lyrics that carry listeners through immersive soundscapes and stories. Their ever evolving and growing bandmates are Laura, Shawn, Aldo, Scott, Alex, and Nikki.

artists.name: Bandits of the Animal Kingdom
artists.desc: Formed in 2019 in Central Washington. They play pop covers & originals with engaging vocal harmonies, ukuleles, mandolin, guitar, bass, sax, clarinet and drums. Bandits perform in the PNW at festivals/events year-round. Put on those dancing shoes!

artists.name: Beckaroos
artists.desc: A Union Wa based band made up of Steve Beck, Jim Moore, Peter Carpentier, Freddy Bear and Maya Diane Johnson.

artists.name: Casey Freedom
artists.desc: A PNW Americana country artist out of Lake Stevens with honest songs, dusty stages and the open road.

artists.name: Champagne Sunday
artists.desc: A husband and wife duo. Jessi and Jared Fredeen tear up stages and crowds nationwide with their unique upbeat, roller coaster style shows, firing off gypsy-punk rock songs alongside everything from intimate tear-jerkers to anthemic foot-stompers, peppering their sets with compelling stories behind their music. Champagne Sunday is one of the rare original acts that performs with stadium-level energy, interacts with their audiences, and affects people in a way that is both emotionally uplifting and genuine. Together, Jessi and Jared have been able to create a sound that’s totally unique, fun, emotional, and captivating, with a show that packs the power of an entire orchestra.

artists.name: Chris Eakes
artists.home: Mason County / South Puget Sound, WA area
artists.desc: A multi-instrumentalist from Lockport, NY. A tiny spec in the background of American Idol Season 4. Chris has been singing his whole life and growing his brand. Shris has traveled the country multiple times entertaining audiences of all ages with his Live Show. His percussive strumming and powerful vocals will trap you while he combines all the technology at his feet to create a sound experience like no other. He is frequently joined by his son Michael on saxophone and piano.

artists.name: Cordurroy Fox
artists.desc: Blends a bit of country, folk, surf, funk and indie rock into their original tracks. Songwriter, Joshua James, was born in Maryland, raised in SoCal, and lives in the PNW, allowing a myriad of sounds, genres, and multicultural experiences to come together to create Corduroy Fox's unique sound; something they refer to as Slop Rock and Dragrass. /CorduroyFox/

artists.name: Curtis Roy Moore
artists.desc: Born in Pensacola, Florida the son of a Navy Chief he has traveled and lived in several countries. Has worked as a crab fisherman in Alaska, shrimper in Florida and in heavy civil construction in Northern Canada and the US. He began playing guitar when he was in elementary school in Belgium when his father bought him his first guitar in 1972. After living in Europe his family moved to the family home in Leavenworth, Washington where he was active in several music projects. From the bars of Key West, Florida in the 80’s to the coast of Canada where he was a founding member of the well-known rock and roll band, Pacific Disturbance which played all over British Columbia and Alberta.

artists.name: Dan Walker
artists.desc: An internationally acclaimed guitarist renowned for his breathtaking acoustic performances. He is also a gun4hire guitarist in Top Tribute Bands. Dan also specializes in live sound reinforcement & hosts popular open mics.

artists.name: Dan Whyms
artists.desc: A Nashville recording artist and Johnny Cash tribute musician based in McCleary, Washington

artists.name: Danica Roxanica
artists.desc: Or Danika Rozhanica is a Creator beyond genre. Her songs are a salve for the spirit, & her voice is honest, filled with an earnestness that can quiet any crowded bar. Her art & her life are entirely devoted to creating an even more beautiful, heartfelt world, where we can live in harmony. Singing on county fair stages since the age of three, her voice shines with the light of the muses, the pure balladry of Ireland's Paul Brady, the modern mystic rhythms of Sierra Ferrell, the open hearted lyricism of Ms. Lauryn Hill, & the deep reverent melodies of Rising Appalachia.

artists.name: Dean Backholm
artists.desc: His music resonates with melody, lyrics, and musicianship. He can be heard at and hired for most any easy listening venue. Ever popular in the Woodinville Winery district, his repertoire includes both originals and covers of popular songs of the 70’s while also representing new and classic popular music. You will find a song to sing along with while you enjoy a sunny patio or a lively tasting room. If you need a fix of good music or have a need for musical entertainment at an event, then Dean could be your man.

artists.name: Dumpster Joe
artists.desc: A 20s & 30s country blues, stringband jazz & jugband tunes.

artists.name: Forest Ray
artists.home: Seattle, WA (formed San Luis Obispo, CA)
artists.desc: A Seattle based folk n’ roll band, Forest Ray, has been described as “spaced-out, down to earth" and "Brit-pop gone country” that sounds like “the band covering Beatles songs no one knew existed”. Through a consistent touring and recording schedule, they have become one of Seattle’s most known active bands. Their sixth studio album, Windfucker (Jebivjetar), was released in January 2024.
artists.instagram: forestrayrecords (listed on the band's Facebook page — verify handle)

artists.name: Fort Vine
artists.desc: An indie-folk-pop duo named after a secret tree fort they built in Manhattan. Their feel-good music embraces every audience with open arms as their strong harmonies resonate with meaningful poetry and fills every venue with positive energy.

artists.name: Gregory Rawlins
artists.desc: He began writing and performing his homespun songs in the mid-2000s and hasn't looked back, recording 15 full-length albums—including Pale Marble Movie and Ma –two drastically different albums, both released this past December 6th. From folk to hard rock to experimental—in bands Sons of Guns, Catskills, Foxgloves, and Cut Hand, nothing seems off the table for exploration. As a soloist, his songs tread through country, blues and folk territory, and are supported by keen observations of the human spirit and poetic imagery.

artists.name: Harmony Ridge
artists.desc: A young folk trio from the Chehalis Valley in Southwest Washington State. Elliott Townsend (tenor and guitar), Maggie MacInnis (alto and Irish drum), and her sister Jessie Erickson (soprano), have been playing music together since 2012. Forming officially in 2016, Harmony Ridge plays a wide range of genres, including historical and modern folk, Celtic and cowboy ballads, WWII standards, a touch of Gospel, and one or two originals, looking always for timeless harmonies and songs people love. Harmony Ridge is a new generation bringing old songs to life, and they strive to present beloved favorites with excellence and charm.

artists.name: Hilary Scott
artists.desc: Has received rave reviews in national and international publications and won multiple awards for her aurally lush and lyrically significant music. Her voice has been described as “absolutely extraordinary in its emotional greatness” (producer Euro Ferrari). In addition to her beautiful voice, Hilary Scott is an accomplished singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist (piano/keys, guitar and violin). Joe Montague of Riveting Riffs sums it up, when he writes: “Hilary Scott is a secret that has been kept from too many for far too long.

artists.name: Humor and Heart Trio
artists.desc: Jess McKeegan and her partner, Mark Iler, as well as Julie Bennett perform as a trio playing Old Pop and Rock Songs, Tropical Rock and Folk Classics.

artists.name: Hurts Like Hell
artists.desc: Having shared stages with The Mick Fleetwood Blues Band,.38 Special, The Outlaws and The Little River Band, Hurts Like Hell is dedicated to creating an electrifying, all-original rock and blues sound that draws on the rich history of our rock forefathers – Jeff Beck, Jimi Hendrix, Led Zeppelin, the Allman Brothers, ZZ Top, Robin Trower and Bo Diddley. Sharing more than a century of experience performing professionally, the four band members have forged their authentic sound through a shared musical vision, a relentless passion for creating music and the use of increasingly rare vintage gear.

artists.name: Isaac Lornitzo
artists.desc: Singer/Songwriter Olympia, WA Lead Singer of Big Blue Van

artists.name: Jill and the Jacks
artists.desc: Jill and the Jacks are a new band bringing fun tunes to stages all over Olympia, and Centralia!

artists.name: Jim Basnight
artists.desc: I started recording solo, and with the Moberlys, in the late 70's and led a pre-grunge original rock and roll scene in his native Seattle, before relocating to NYC in 1980. He’s been working live and releasing records ever since. Armed in NY with his first album "The Moberlys" (on Seattle's Safety First Label), he received critical acclaim in NY from among others Trouser Press, New York Rocker and Rolling Stone Record Guide. Jim has appeared with acts such as the Ramones, the Police, the Romantics, the Band and Billy Idol and has shared stages with original members of Blondie, Guns and Roses, Heart, New York Dolls, Paul Revere and the Raiders, Janes Addiction, REM, Nirvana and Pearl Jam.

artists.name: Joel Gibson Jr.
artists.desc: Joel Gibson Jr. is a Pacific Northwest (PNW) country and southern rock artist from Silverdale, Washington. Award-Winning Nashville Recording Artist.

artists.name: Joey Dean
artists.desc: A Queer indie pop singer Joey Dean has spent the last six years wrestling with his place in an unrequited world and a congested music industry. He's sought to create a safe space for those who've felt peripheral and different, for those who don't color inside the lines and don't recognize the status quo as their form of homeostasis. Often reflected in his queer peers, or fellow "queerdos" as Dean likes to refer to them, this sentiment fuels the friction of Dean's music. Hard, yet soft. Delicate, yet ever-present. Dean pairs his ambient, synth-driven productions with soaring powerful vocals.

artists.name: Josh Meeks
artists.desc: A singer songwriter and a local favorite in Union, Wa. He is also part of the Duo called Maid Marian

artists.name: Katie Wade
artists.desc: A PNW-based country singer, songwriter, recording artist, and sought-after vocal coach and performer, Kaitie first launched her career in Nashville nearly a decade ago after earning a Vocal Performance degree from Belmont University during her six years in Music City, Kaitie became a familiar face while performing on Broadway—Nashville’s famous strip. She has since shared stages with major country stars including Russell Dickerson, Riley Green, Alexandra Kay, Adam Craig, Craig Morgan, Logan Mize and more. in 2024, she was recognized as a NW-CMA nominee, and in 2025 a WINNER.

artists.name: Kitty Mae
artists.desc: Born and raised in Washington state, Kitty Mae grew up with a love for country music, horses, and rhinestones. A true Cascade Cowgirl, she started singing the national anthem at fairs and rodeos and later became a familiar face busking at Seattle’s Pike Place market. Her sound blends the storytelling of classic country, with the fire of today’s country rock. Influenced by artists like Miranda Lambert, Dolly Parton, Gretchen Wilson, and The Chicks, Kitty Mae writes and performs songs about real life- heartbreak, strong women, Honky-Tonk Nights, and chasing your dreams.

artists.name: Kyle Thompson
artists.desc: Lead singer for Levon Blue from Texas

artists.name: Lakin Saucedo
artists.desc: A rare artists that can be both raw and refined—expressing deeply personal truths with poetic lyrics and stately songwriting. Garnering favorable comparisons to Alicia Keys, John Mayer, and Sara Bareilles, Lakin has had the distinction of opening for such acts as Sheryl Crow, Colbie Caillat, Brian McKnight, Gladys Knight, and Maddie & Tae. In addition to these marquee engagements, Lakin remains a fixture around college campuses, having played 100 colleges across the US over the past several years. A native Southern Californian, Lakin grew up in a musical household. Her father is an accomplished jazz musician who toured with George Benson.

artists.name: Liquid Horse
artists.desc: An original Northwest Country Band

artists.name: Maid Marion
artists.desc: Maid Marion is Josh Meeks performing with other musicians backing him. He also plays solo under his own name around Mason County.

artists.name: Mega Rays
artists.desc: Delivers high-energy covers of modern country & musical hits from 1990s to 2010s — empowering anthems, emotional ballads & party tunes. Fresh originals & images co-created with AI. Live acoustic & full-band shows that get crowds singing & dancing.

artists.name: Monty Banks
artists.desc: A Seattle native who makes New Orleans home from October through May, returning to Seattle for the summers. A pianist, vocalist, and bandleader in the Rat Pack-era swing tradition, his own description of the act runs from Sinatra-style swing through Jelly Roll Morton's syncopated blues to Fats Domino's Creole boogie. He's played New York, Las Vegas, and cruise ships, but in New Orleans he's a regular at Irene's Cuisine, the Carousel Lounge, the Roosevelt's Fountain Lounge, the Spotted Cat, and Fritzel's, and he played French Quarter Fest 2025 with the High Rollers.

artists.name: Nikko from Nikko and the Night Shift
Norman Baker
artists.desc: Traveling, creating and sharing original live music are a few essential ingredients for the enrichment of humanity. Norman Baker and his band pay homage to this fact by introducing new and old songs to as many communities as possible. His band utilizes undertones of pedal steel, mandolin, banjo, upright bass, clarinet and of course an onslaught of acoustic and electric guitars telling stories of loss, loss prevention, camping, driving without cell phones, childlike innocence, hometowns and walking till your shows wear through.

artists.name: Randy Linder
artists.desc: A veteran classic rock musician and tribute artist known for his nationally and internationally acclaimed project, Randy Linder's Creedence Revelation, which honors John Fogerty and Creedence Clearwater Revival (CCR).

artists.name: Rob Hill
artists.desc: A Union local and one of tropical rock’s most respected singer-songwriters, known for crafting songs that transport listeners straight to the shore. Blending elements of country, rock, reggae, and island music, his lyric-driven style turns the beach into a symbol of escape, adventure, and living fully.

artists.name: Robert Poole
artists.desc: Rocking the PNW since the 60s, Robert channels the spirit of icons such as Dylan, The Byrds, The Moody Blues. With a powerful voice and soulful guitar, he bridges eras - timeless classics meet mesmerizing originals.

artists.name: Ryan Foskett
artists.desc: A local singer songwriter guitarist from Belfair

artists.name: Ryan Yates
artists.desc: An Americana, country, rockabilly, and surf punk musician and upright bassist based out of Olympia, WA. Lead Singer for Yotes.

artists.name: Sammy Steele
artists.home: North Dakota-born, Pacific Northwest-raised; now splits time between the Northwest and Wyoming
artists.desc: A Pacific Northwest-based country, alternative country, and southern rock band.

artists.name: Scott Lesman
artists.desc: A Union, WA singer-songwriter guitarist playing originals and covers. He also runs open mic at Hood Canale in Union and Nicole’s Bar in Olympia. The Scott Lesman Duo includes Neal McCrae Loewen on drums.

artists.name: Scott Lesman Duo
artists.desc: Two-piece act led by Union-based musician Scott Lesman, described by Hood Canalé as two musicians playing anything from Motown to classic rock along with a good deal of their own original material. Scott Lesman is listed as a musician member of the North Mason Chamber of Commerce in Union, and the duo plays regularly around Hood Canal and the Kitsap Peninsula.

artists.name: Sean Curkendall
artists.desc: He has been playing piano for over 30 years. He has a wide range of genres that he plays well and is familiar with. He has played for such greats as Billy Shew, Randy Oxford, Rafiel Tranchlimino, Micheal Powers, Vicci Martinez, Jumpin Josh, and more.

artists.name: Suped Up Fjord
artists.desc: Suped up Fjord is a Bad Ass Cover Band from Union, WA who play both kinds of music, Rock AND Roll. Available in a Duo, Trio or Full Band.

artists.name: The Action Figures
artists.desc: A rock band based in Olympia, Washington, known for their punk, classic hard metal, and retro-style sound.

artists.name: The Brothers Rowe
artists.desc: Street Rats from Mt. Rainier making tunes. Hope you all enjoy.

artists.name: The Fabulous Murph Tones
artists.desc: A high-energy 5-piece cover band based in the Pacific Northwest (Seattle area) active since 1991. They perform a diverse mix of popular dance, rock, classic rock, old-school hits (from the 1960s through the 2000s), and current rock hits. Their catalog includes deep cuts and crowd-pleasers not typically covered by other bands.

artists.name: The Lady Drinks Whiskey
artists.desc: A stylistically unique Blues, Rock Cover Band. The Lady Drinks Whiskey has been winning the hearts of music lovers from all walks of life. Performing a variety of music from The Beatles to The Beach Boys, Janis Joplin and Elvis to Willie Nelson and much more, The Lady Drinks Whiskey plays multi generational crowd favorites with a strong focus on vocal harmonies!

artists.name: The Mistaken
artists.desc: Genre-bending Originals, Swing-A-Billy, Twang, Folk, Country, Blues and more. Music outside the box.

artists.name: The Rainier Project
artists.desc: An acoustic musical act featuring two acoustic guitars playing an eclectic mix of blues, classic rock, and finger-picking arrangements.

artists.name: The Rehearsals
artists.desc: A local musical group based in Union, Washington, featuring a blend of original compositions and covers led by songwriter Randy Baugh.

artists.name: The Shoemaker Brothers
artists.home: Originally Shelton & Mason County, WA; later based in Los Angeles, CA
artists.desc: An American folk-rock and alternative band composed of four sibling musicians from Shelton, Washington: Samuel, Nathanael, Daniel, and Gabriel Shoemaker.

artists.name: The Spin-Offs
artists.desc: Pacific Northwest Blues/Roots Band originating from the All-Star Women's Blues Jam at Spinnaker Bay Brewing in Hillman City, this blues, funk, soul, and rock-roots band features Dawnzella Gearhart (vocals), "Mikey G" Gearhart (bass), Daniel Neumeyer (guitar), Lea Weber (drums), and Jeff Herzog (harmonica/vocals).

artists.name: The Varmints
artists.desc: A live band performing classic rock and roll across local Washington venues and events.

artists.name: Union City Council
artists.desc: A traditional and old-time bluegrass quintet based in the Pacific Northwest, drawing its members from across the South Puget Sound and the Hood Canal region in Washington.

artists.name: Yotes
artists.desc: Shares a mix of covers, deep cuts, and original rockabilly, country, and Americana tunes.

artists.name: Cody Bartels
artists.desc: A country, blues, and rock singer-songwriter from Tacoma WA.

artists.name: Ethan Tucker
artists.desc: Plays acoustic roots and layered electric guitars, combined with an unmistakable soulful and bluesy vocal. Born in Olympia, WA, Ethan has performed around the world, touring nationally with Jimmy Cliff, Buddy Guy, and The Wailers, as well as national support slots with musical peers Slightly Stoopid, G.Love and Special Sauce and many others. He has performed at premiere national festivals such as Bottle Rock, Cali Vibes Fest, California Roots, Kaboo, Hangout, and Slightly Stoopid’s Mexico destination event Closer To The Sun. In addition, he has been invited to perform at notable film festivals including Sundance, Sun Valley and Mill Valley Film Festivals.

artists.name: Tarik Bentlemsani
artists.desc: A guitarist based in Olympia, Washington. He can be seen playing Jazz, Classical, World, Funk, Pop, Rock and Bluegrass music, or anything else he is called on to play. His solo guitar style uses extended techniques, percussive effects, and alternate tunings to create the illusion of more than one musician playing. Using rich harmonic content and virtuosic melodic passages, Tarik is able to play bass-lines, chords, melodies and percussion simultaneously. Most of the projects Tarik is involved with bend and blend genres in some way or another.

artists.name: Billy Shew
artists.desc: A multi-talented musician, who carries a passion for connecting with people through music. He has become known for his soulful guitar playing, real life inspiration in songwriting, sultry vocals and putting his heart and soul into his performances. Billy has the talent, skill, and competency to move effortlessly between all genres. Whether it is country, blues, or classic rock, his authenticity, heart, and guitar style come together to create an unbelievable energy that is both powerful and personal. No two shows are ever the same, which reflects Billy’s belief that great live music should be spontaneous, honest, and full of emotion.
